name: medshapenet
title: MedShapeNet: 106 101 anatomical and surgical-instrument shapes as STL meshes
description: The MedShapeNet collection (IKIM, University Hospital Essen): over 100 000 3-D shapes extracted from 23 medical datasets - organs, bones, vessels, tumours, teeth, instruments - as STL files, one per URL in the public download index (sciebo, HTTP Range supported). Sample ids are case/structure (426 structure names, e.g. liver, vertebrae, skull, tumoredbrain); ds.filter(structure='liver') selects one anatomy. STL carries no unit: shapes derived from medical images are in millimetres (declared here, TO CONFIRM for the instrument sets).

license.note: MedShapeNetCore on Zenodo is CC BY 4.0 (checked 2026-10-14); the full collection inherits the licence of each source dataset, TO CONFIRM per structure before commercial use or redistribution.

citation: Li J., Zhou Z., Yang J., et al. MedShapeNet - A Large-Scale Dataset of 3D Medical Shapes for Computer Vision. Biomedical Engineering / Biomedizinische Technik, 2024. arXiv:2308.16139.

mesh.description: Triangle mesh of one anatomical structure (STL, millimetres)
